CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_identity_keys()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO zoi.seo_identity_keys VALUES
 (NEW.id,zoi.seo_name(NEW.name,NEW.city),zoi.seo_text(NEW.city),zoi.seo_text(NEW.region),zoi.seo_text(NEW.country),zoi.seo_text(NEW.address))
 ON CONFLICT (listing_id) DO UPDATE SET name_key=EXCLUDED.name_key,city_key=EXCLUDED.city_key,
 region_key=EXCLUDED.region_key,country_key=EXCLUDED.country_key,address_key=EXCLUDED.address_key;
 RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_source_generation(p_listing uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT source_generation FROM zoi.geography_repair_jobs WHERE listing_id=p_listing ORDER BY source_generation DESC,id LIMIT 1),0)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.schema_type(p_entity text, p_cat text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_entity='event' then 'Event'
    when p_entity='church' then 'Church'
    when p_entity='school' then 'EducationalOrganization'
    when p_entity='organization' then 'Organization'
    when p_entity='venue' then 'EventVenue'
    when p_entity in ('creator','artist') then 'Person'
    when p_entity='travel_place' then 'TouristAttraction'
    when p_entity='product' then 'Product'
    when p_entity='vendor' then 'Store'
    when p_entity='professional' then case p_cat
         when 'lawyers' then 'Attorney' when 'dentists' then 'Dentist'
         when 'doctors' then 'Physician' when 'accountants' then 'AccountingService'
         when 'realtors' then 'RealEstateAgent' when 'insurance' then 'InsuranceAgency'
         else 'ProfessionalService' end
    when p_entity='business' then case p_cat
         when 'restaurants' then 'Restaurant' when 'tavernas' then 'Restaurant'
         when 'bakeries' then 'Bakery' when 'cafes' then 'CafeOrCoffeeShop'
         when 'groceries' then 'GroceryStore' when 'specialty-food' then 'GroceryStore'
         else 'LocalBusiness' end
    else 'LocalBusiness' end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_repair_strategy_input(l zoi.listings, p_strategy text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_strategy='publisher_profiles_v1' THEN md5(jsonb_build_object('base',zoi.geography_repair_input(l),'blocked_reason',l.profile#>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}','scope_review_required',l.profile#>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}','organization_identity_quarantine',l.profile#>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}')::text) ELSE zoi.geography_repair_input(l) END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_read_authority_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF zoi.geography_read_authority_input(OLD) IS DISTINCT FROM zoi.geography_read_authority_input(NEW) THEN
   UPDATE zoi.geography_read_authority_epochs SET epoch=epoch+1 WHERE listing_id=NEW.id;
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_read_authority_input(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'schema',1,'listing_id',l.id,'entity_type',l.entity_type,'name',l.name,
 'legal_name',l.legal_name,'display_name',l.display_name,
 'address',l.address,'city',l.city,'country',l.country,'region',l.region,
 'province_state',l.province_state,'neighborhood',l.neighborhood,'region_id',l.region_id,
 'place_id',l.place_id,'region_code',l.region_code,'region_native',l.region_native,
 'website',l.website,'source_id',l.source_id,'source_url',l.source_url,
 'source_type',l.source_type,'source_trust_tier',l.source_trust_tier,
 'claim_status',l.claim_status,'verification_status',l.verification_status,
 'field_authority',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,v),'{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.field_meta)='object' THEN l.field_meta ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS f(k,v) WHERE k IN('name','legal_name','display_name','address','city','country','region','province_state','latitude','longitude','geo_precision','website','source_url','source_id','source_type','place_id')),
 'owner_user',l.owner_user_id,'owner_workspace',l.owner_workspace_id,
 'publish_status',l.publish_status,'moderation_status',l.moderation_status,
 'marketplace_status',l.marketplace_status,'duplicate_status',l.duplicate_status,
 'latitude',l.latitude,'longitude',l.longitude,'precision',l.geo_precision,
 'geo_provenance',l.profile->'_geo',
 'published_overrides',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,v),'{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.profile)='object' THEN l.profile ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS f(k,v) WHERE k IN('name','legal_name','display_name','address','city','country','region','province_state','neighborhood','website','latitude','longitude','geo_precision','location','locations','branches')),
 'source_authority',jsonb_build_object(
   'source_url',l.profile#>'{_enrich,source_url}','source_kind',l.profile#>'{_enrich,source_kind}',
   'identity_scope',l.profile#>'{_enrich,identity_scope}',
   'source_identity',l.profile#>'{_enrich,source_identity}',
   'source_scope_mismatch',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_scope_mismatch}'='true',false),
   'scope_mismatch_reason',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch',false),
   'scope_review_required',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true',false),
   'organization_identity_quarantine',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true',false),
   'blocked',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked}'='true',false),
   'source_challenge',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_challenge}'='true',false)
 ))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_place_norm(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(lower(normalize(value,NFKC)),'[[:punct:][:space:]]+',' ','g')) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_read_source_allowed(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT(coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_scope_mismatch}'='true',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_kind}'='association_member',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,identity_scope}'='organization' AND l.entity_type IN('artist','creator','professional'),false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked}'='true',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,source_challenge}'='true',false))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.profile)='object' THEN l.profile ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS f(k,v)
 WHERE k IN('name','address','city','country','website','latitude','longitude','geo_precision')
 AND v IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(l)->k)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_pluralize(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when p ~ '(ch|sh|s|x|z)$' then p||'es'
    when p ~ '[^aeiou]y$'     then regexp_replace(p,'y$','ies')
    else p||'s'
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.claim_owner_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.owner_workspace_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.owner_workspace_id OR NEW.owner_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.owner_user_id THEN
  INSERT INTO zoi.listing_claim_authority(listing_id)VALUES(NEW.id) ON CONFLICT(listing_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=gen_random_uuid();
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_publisher_host(p_url text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN length(p_url)<=2000 AND p_url~*'^https?://[a-z0-9.-]+([/?#]|$)' THEN regexp_replace(lower(substring(p_url from '(?i)^https?://([^/?#]+)')),'^www\.','') ELSE NULL END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_source_authority_input(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT md5(jsonb_build_object('source_scope_mismatch',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch',false),'scope_review_required',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true',false),'organization_identity_quarantine',coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true',false))::text)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_text(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
 SELECT pg_catalog.btrim(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(p_value,'')), '[^[:alnum:]]+', ' ', 'g'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_repair_input(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT md5(jsonb_build_object('name',l.name,'entity_type',l.entity_type,'address',l.address,'city',l.city,'country',l.country,'website',l.website,'source_url',l.source_url,'latitude',l.latitude,'longitude',l.longitude,'precision',l.geo_precision,'geo',l.profile->'_geo','owner_user',l.owner_user_id,'owner_workspace',l.owner_workspace_id,'published',l.publish_status,'moderation',l.moderation_status,'marketplace',l.marketplace_status,'duplicate',l.duplicate_status)::text)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_slug(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case when p is null then null else
    trim(both '-' from regexp_replace(lower(p), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g'))
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geography_reviewed_point(p_listing uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('listing_id',l.id,'request_id',r.request_id,
 'latitude',l.latitude,'longitude',l.longitude,'precision',l.geo_precision)
 FROM zoi.listings l JOIN zoi.geography_reviews r ON r.listing_id=l.id AND r.request_id=CASE WHEN l.profile#>>'{_geo,request_id}'~'^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' THEN (l.profile#>>'{_geo,request_id}')::uuid ELSE NULL END
 WHERE l.id=p_listing AND l.publish_status='published' AND l.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared')
 AND l.marketplace_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'hidden'
 AND l.duplicate_status <> 'confirmed_duplicate'
 AND l.owner_user_id IS NULL AND l.owner_workspace_id IS NULL
 AND r.reverted_at IS NULL AND zoi.geography_read_source_allowed(l) AND CASE WHEN r.read_authority_fingerprint IS NULL THEN r.after_fingerprint=zoi.geography_fingerprint(l) ELSE r.read_authority_fingerprint=zoi.geography_read_authority_fingerprint(l) END
 AND l.profile->'_geo'->>'request_id'=r.request_id::text
 AND r.receipt->>'listing_id'=l.id::text AND r.receipt->>'request_id'=r.request_id::text
 AND r.receipt->'latitude'=to_jsonb(l.latitude) AND r.receipt->'longitude'=to_jsonb(l.longitude)
 AND r.receipt->>'precision'=l.geo_precision AND l.geo_precision='street'
 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_publisher_held(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,blocked_reason}'='source_scope_mismatch',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,scope_review_required}'='true',false)
 OR coalesce(l.profile#>>'{_enrich,organization_identity_quarantine}'='true',false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_source_eligible(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT l.owner_user_id IS NULL AND l.owner_workspace_id IS NULL AND l.marketplace_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'hidden' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zoi.v_public_listings e WHERE e.id=l.id)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_read_authority_fingerprint(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('authority',zoi.geography_read_authority_input(l),'epoch',e.epoch)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 FROM zoi.geography_read_authority_epochs e WHERE e.listing_id=l.id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geography_fingerprint(p_listing zoi.listings)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT md5(to_jsonb(p_listing)::text)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_projection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN UPDATE zoi.seo_identity_keys k SET slug=NEW.slug,entity_type=NEW.entity_type,updated_at=coalesce(NEW.updated_at,NEW.created_at),
 completeness=(((NEW.address IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.phone IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.website IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.latitude IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.description IS NOT NULL)::int)),
 ugly=(NEW.slug ~ '-[0-9a-f]{6}$')::int,
 is_indexable=coalesce(NEW.publish_status='published' AND NEW.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(NEW.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND NEW.duplicate_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'confirmed_duplicate'
 AND nullif(btrim(NEW.slug),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(NEW.name),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND (NEW.city IS NOT NULL OR NEW.address IS NOT NULL OR NEW.website IS NOT NULL),false)
WHERE k.listing_id=NEW.id;
 RETURN NEW; END $function$

public_listing_view:
SELECT l.id,
    l.entity_type,
    l.name,
    l.slug,
    l.description,
    c.slug AS category_slug,
    c.label_en AS category,
    l.city,
    l.region,
    l.province_state,
    l.country,
    l.latitude,
    l.longitude,
    l.website,
    l.trust_badges,
    l.verification_status,
    l.updated_at
   FROM zoi.listings l
     LEFT JOIN zoi.categories c ON c.id = l.primary_category_id
  WHERE l.publish_status = 'published'::text AND (l.moderation_status = ANY (ARRAY['clean'::text, 'cleared'::text])) AND l.duplicate_status <> 'confirmed_duplicate'::text;
